payload.title: IPC design v5 — strictly fail-closed journal recovery + API precision

journal_recovery.correction_accepted: Clean-prefix resume assumes damage is localized. Withdrawing the v4 torn-record-discard rule entirely.
journal_recovery.revised_rule: Any torn, unclassifiable, checksum-failed, or otherwise damaged journal record -> the owner fails closed. Full stop. No clean-prefix resume, no intent inference from partial bytes, no setup re-seeding.
journal_recovery.what_happens: All routes enter uncertainty hold. The original journal file is preserved byte-for-byte (renamed aside, never overwritten or repaired in place). The owner refuses all verbs except status. Recovery requires independent trusted reconciliation: a trusted party examines the preserved journal, establishes the permitted recovery state out-of-band, and explicitly authorizes resumption with a fresh journal seeded from the reconciled state.
journal_recovery.what_does_not_clear: Fresh authority alone does not clear an unresolved operation. A new approval does not restore a consumed allowance from a damaged journal. No client verb — including any reconciliation-shaped verb — can clear the hold.
journal_recovery.no_tail_classification: Agreed: no elaborate scheme for classifying tail damage. Damaged is damaged; the rule is uniform.

api_precision.correction_accepted: FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE is a desired-access right, not a dwOpenMode flag. Withdrawing the v4 conflation.
api_precision.dwOpenMode: PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX | PIPE_TYPE_MESSAGE | PIPE_READMODE_MESSAGE | PIPE_WAIT | PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS. These are the documented open-mode flags.
api_precision.client_dacl: Separately, in the security descriptor: grant the client SID FILE_READ_DATA | FILE_WRITE_DATA | SYNCHRONIZE. FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE appears only in access masks, never in dwOpenMode.
api_precision.server_dacl: Owner SID holds full control on the pipe; no other SIDs granted.

payload.acceptance_restated: After a partial intent or outcome write and restart: no dispatch, no lease transfer, no replay, no allowance reset — until trusted reconciliation establishes the permitted recovery state. The preserved original journal remains available as evidence throughout.
payload.v4_points_standing: Coordinator.gate as the single gate, final pre-dispatch expiry validation, uncertainty barrier, no-automatic-replay, exact client/server masks, observed SID identity — all stand unchanged.

implementation_plan.scope: Source-only. Produces reviewed source + offline tests. No listener started, no pipe created, no DACL applied, no live dispatch.
deliverables: 1. journal.py: append-only journal with length-prefixed checksummed records, fsync per record, fail-closed loader (any damage -> raise, never partial-load).

2. owner_ipc.py: pipe server skeleton using pywin32 with the exact dwOpenMode flags and DACL from this design; connection handler performing SID/session observation via GetNamedPipeClientProcessId + token query.
3. dispatch.py: single Coordinator.gate critical section implementing the v2/v3 check sequence with final pre-dispatch validation, write-ahead intent, backend invocation, outcome write.
4. frames.py: length-prefixed bounded frames (4-byte BE length, 1MB cap), strict canonical-JSON-v1 schema validation, no pickle anywhere.
implementation_plan.offline_tests: Fake transport (in-process): all v4 acceptance cases (zero expired starts, uncertainty without duplicates, damaged journal fail-closed, correct gate serialization) plus v5 (torn record -> full hold, no clean-prefix resume; partial intent bytes never inferred).
implementation_plan.not_in_plan: No Windows host execution, no pipe creation, no live backend, no GUI input. Activation (listener standup, DACL application, live dispatch qualification) is a separate future gate requiring its own review and Bruce's authorization.
implementation_plan.owner_approval_needed: Design freeze on v5 + approval to write the source-only implementation. Nothing runs.

payload.scope_restated: Design delta + implementation plan. No code written yet, no implementation authorized by this packet — the plan is for owner approval.
